title: Two Lightning Text models join a sturdier API
summary:
New text models and SDK tools arrived alongside more reliable generation, better keyboard access and room for eight running sandboxes.

InferencePort Lightning Text v2 and v2.1 were added with image input, tool use, JSON output and 128,000-token context windows. Image edits now forward all accepted reference images for MAI and Grok models, Qwen Image 3 has a Pro-model fallback, and Claude routing gained an AWS fallback. Chat streams with no output are no longer cached, and failed Floret streams report a generation error.

The SDK added 3D generation, model-status queries, speech with timestamps, five React generation hooks and a transport for AI SDK useChat. CLI JSON-mode login now shows users how to approve device sign-in; MCP model checks and balance responses are clearer, and SDK errors preserve useful gateway messages. The REST agent skill also gained user-approved device sign-in instructions.

Dashboard and Playground controls gained better-connected labels, more visible keyboard focus and tooltips that stay on screen and work with screen readers. Theme state is more consistent, system color-mode changes are followed when no override is saved, and disabled controls behave as disabled controls should.

daily.title: Lightning Text v2 and v2.1
daily.text: Try two InferencePort text models with 128,000-token context windows, image input, tool use and JSON output. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: 3D generation in the SDK
daily.text: Use `model3d()` to generate a 3D file from a public reference image, with options for resolution, seed and safety. [Explore the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

daily.title: Speech with word timings
daily.text: Use `audioSpeechWithTimestamps()` to get speech audio, character alignments and derived word timings in one SDK response. [Explore the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

daily.title: Model health in the SDK
daily.text: Query model health and metadata with `modelStatus()`, including traffic and rolling-window filters. [Explore the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

daily.title: React generation hooks
daily.text: Build with headless hooks for image, text, audio, video and transcription generation. Each provides loading and error state, plus run, rerun and cancel controls. [Explore the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

daily.title: Pollinations transport for useChat
daily.text: Connect AI SDK `useChat` to streaming Pollinations responses with `usePollinationsChatTransport`, including usage and server-run MCP tool results. [Explore the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).
